newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: IFE sees 1996 pretax jumping 45 percent.
newsitem.headline: IFE sees 1996 pretax jumping 45 percent.

text.p: Austrian manufacturer of automatic doors IFE Industrie-Einrichtungen Fertigungs-AG said on Wednesday it expects 1996 pre-tax profit to jump 45 percent to 54 million schillings.

Reporting earnings for the first six months, IFE said group sales slipped to 567.9 million schillings from 605 million in the year-ago period, while pre-tax profit climbed to 32.3 million from 29.7 million.
Last year, IFE posted a pre-tax profit of 37.3 million.
IFE is a subsidiary of Germany's Rothenberger. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 274
